## TDD

- TDD used: full / partial / none  
  Examples: full, partial, none

- What shows this:  
  Examples:  
  - unit tests were written before implementation  
  - failing test commit came before implementation commit  
  - tests were added after the feature was implemented  
  - backend validation tests were written first

- Effect on work:  
  Examples:  
  - slower at first, but easier to debug  
  - helped clarify expected behavior  
  - faster to code first for UI work  
  - made refactoring safer  
  - little noticeable impact
